user.title: Connect to Sophos Firewall
user.description: Enter the API user you created for Home Assistant (Authentication > Users, type Administrator, with read/write rights). API access must be enabled under Backup & Firmware > API, with Home Assistant's IP allowed.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed - check the username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the firewall at that host/port. Check the address, port, and that API access is enabled and allows this IP.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while contacting the firewall.

add_rule.title: Add a firewall rule
add_rule.description: Enter the exact rule Name as it appears in the Sophos firewall (Rules and policies). A switch entity will be created for it.

error.rule_not_found: No firewall rule with that exact name was found.
